items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you ever meet -- speaking of composers, did you ever meet Jelly Roll Morton? [INTERVIEWEE] Jelly Roll Morton, band man from Kansas City?

ctx.x: is why Roy Eldridge -- took him a long time to get used to that band, because he played in regular keys, B flat, E flat, C's, F's, and like that. When you go into those A flats and A sharps, all that kind of stuff, took him a long time to get with it. He admitted it, too. He said they're playing in too many keys. Yeah. Great band, Fletcher's band. Saw a lot of young drummers in here.
